crushH.q1: When do you think about him?
crushH.q1a: Mostly when I run into him
crushH.q1b: From time to time, it's fine
crushH.q1d: All the time, even when I should be thinking about something else
crushH.q2: How long has this been going on?
crushH.q2d: More than six months, and it isn't fading
crushH.q3a: I think about my day, like everyone
crushH.q3c: I often replay things he said or did
crushH.q3d: He's my end-of-day thought, almost every night
crushH.q4: Have you ever imagined scenes that never actually happened?
crushH.q4d: Whole bits of the future: holidays, later on, all of it
crushH.q5: When his name pops up on your screen…
crushH.q5c: I smile before I've even opened it
crushH.q5d: My heart speeds up, and I feel ridiculous
crushH.q6: He takes three hours to reply. What do you do?
crushH.q6c: I check my phone every ten minutes
crushH.q6d: It nags at me all day
crushH.q7: His stories, what do you do with them?
crushH.q7a: I see them go by, like everyone's
crushH.q7b: I watch them all, that's true
crushH.q8: Do you ever scroll back through your old conversations?
crushH.q8d: I reread certain messages I almost know by heart
crushH.q9: Ever typed out a message, then deleted it without sending?
crushH.q10: When he's physically close to you…
crushH.q10b: I pay a bit more attention to myself
crushH.q10c: I get warm, or shivers, take your pick
crushH.q10d: My body notices him before I do
crushH.q11: Someone says his name in a conversation…
crushH.q11c: I focus on not showing anything
crushH.q11d: I feel my cheeks heat up
crushH.q12: Right before seeing him, your stomach…
crushH.q12d: Is in knots, to the point it shows
crushH.q13: Do you ever smile for no reason, remembering a moment with him?
crushH.q13c: Yes, and I crack myself up
crushH.q14: Has your sleep or appetite changed lately?
crushH.q14b: I sleep a bit worse, maybe
crushH.q14c: My mind wanders while eating, that yes
crushH.q14d: Honestly yes, and I know because of whom
crushH.q15: When you know he'll be somewhere…
crushH.q15b: It makes me a bit more keen to go
crushH.q15c: It flat-out decides whether I go or not
crushH.q15d: I go because of it, even if I won't admit it
crushH.q16: Before going somewhere you might run into him…
crushH.q16a: I dress like I always do
crushH.q16b: One extra look in the mirror, fine
crushH.q16c: I pick my outfit with him in mind
crushH.q16d: I plan it the night before
crushH.q17: Do you ever take detours to cross his path?
crushH.q17b: Let's say I don't avoid them
crushH.q17d: My route has been optimised for weeks
crushH.q18: In a room he's in, your eyes…
crushH.q18d: Drift back to him on their own, I can't help it
crushH.q19a: Don't know, there's nothing to tell
crushH.q19b: Have heard about it once or twice
crushH.q19d: Have already told me I talk about nothing else
crushH.q20: When someone criticises him in front of you…
crushH.q20d: It annoys me way more than it should
crushH.q21: What he tells you about his life, how much do you keep?
crushH.q21d: Everything. I can bring up something he said a month ago
crushH.q22: Can you name any of his flaws?
crushH.q22a: I don't know him well enough to answer
crushH.q22b: None. He's perfect, which is a problem
crushH.q22c: A few, and I find them cute
crushH.q22d: Yes, I see them clearly, and it changes nothing
crushH.q23: What is it you like about him, exactly?
crushH.q23d: I can't explain it. The way he is, just him
crushH.q24: When he talks to you directly…
crushH.q24b: I'm careful about what I say
crushH.q24c: I replay the conversation in my head afterwards
crushH.q24d: I lose it a little, and hope it doesn't show
crushH.q25a: He doesn't even know I exist
crushH.q25b: We say hi, we cross paths
crushH.q25c: We chat from time to time
crushH.q26: Could you see yourself telling him really personal stuff?
crushH.q26d: It's already the case, and I do it with no one else
crushH.q27: You see him laughing with another girl. Reaction?
crushH.q27a: None, he does what he wants
crushH.q27b: I still check who it is
crushH.q27d: It wrecks my mood for a while
crushH.q28: If he got into a relationship tomorrow…
crushH.q28b: It would sting, but it would pass
crushH.q28d: I'd rather not even picture it
crushH.q29: He's away for a week. Holidays, sick, whatever.
crushH.q29b: I notice, it's different without him
crushH.q29d: The week loses all interest, might as well stay home
crushH.q30: When someone else shows interest in you…
crushH.q30b: I compare a little, despite myself
crushH.q30c: I compare everyone to him, and nobody wins
crushH.q30d: It doesn't even interest me anymore, which is the problem
crushH.q31: Right after seeing him, how do you feel?
crushH.q31c: I replay the scene two or three times
crushH.q31d: I need a moment to come back down
crushH.q32: When you're with him, you feel mostly…
crushH.q32c: Stressed at first, then really good
crushH.q32d: In the right place. That's what troubles me most
crushH.q33: His relationship status, do you know it?
crushH.q33a: No idea, and I don't care
crushH.q33c: A little discreet investigation, let's say
crushH.q34: Do you want something to actually happen?
crushH.q34a: Not necessarily. I like just thinking about it
crushH.q34b: I don't really know what I want
crushH.q34c: Yes, but I don't dare make a move
crushH.q34d: Yes, and I'm thinking about how
crushH.q35: Deep down, what would you call this?
crushH.q35c: More than a crush, I think
crushH.modesDesc: We need it to write the questions about him or about her.
crushH.modeHommeDesc: The questions will be about him.
crushH.modeFemmeDesc: The questions will be about her.
